gloss: point of similarity; resemblance; common feature

definitions.gloss: point of similarity; resemblance; common feature
definitions.explanation: a specific aspect or feature in which two or more things are similar

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{類似点|るいじてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are similarities between the two cases.

examples.japanese: {類似点|るいじてん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{相違点|そういてん}→相違点：17928_souiten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧みよう。
examples.english: Let's compare the similarities and differences.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{韓国語|かんこくご}→韓国語：25419_kankokugo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文法|ぶんぽう}→文法：01506_bunpou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{類似点|るいじてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: Many similarities can be observed in the grammar of Japanese and Korean.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{類似|るいじ}→類似：14672_ruiji⟧ (resemblance/similarity) and ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point/aspect). A formal, analytical term commonly used in academic writing, comparisons, and analysis. Often paired with its antonym ⟦{相違点|そういてん}→相違点：17928_souiten⟧ (point of difference).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {類似点|るいじてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there are similarities
- {類似点|るいじてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: to list similarities
- {類似点|るいじてん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{相違点|そういてん}→相違点：17928_souiten⟧: similarities and differences
- {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{類似点|るいじてん}: many similarities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{共通点|きょうつうてん}→共通点：03051_kyoutsuuten⟧: common point — what things share, emphasizes what is the same
- ⟦{相違点|そういてん}→相違点：17928_souiten⟧: point of difference — the opposite: where things differ
- ⟦{類似性|るいじせい}→類似性：21772_ruijisei⟧: similarity — the abstract quality of being similar, not a specific point
